GenAiPlugin.description: Handles any question about an order, including delivery, payments, charges, money and anything that went wrong with it.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Always ask for the order number if it is missing. Help the customer with whatever they need for the order, including payment and money questions.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to look up an existing order and answer any question about it: shipping, delivery, payment status, charges and problems with the order.
